thread:
sara: Huge thanks to @kyle and @devops for saving the demo backdrop at 11pm last night 
The banner was a crime scene and you two showed up with gaffer tape and optimism :raised_hands:
liam: Kyle MacGyvered a tension rod out of a broom handle and two zip ties. legendary :zipper_mouth_face:
devops: all in a night's work. shoutout to @people-ops for sending the ladder and a mysterious thermos of coffee that kept us upright :wrench: :coffee:
kyle: couldn't have done it without sara's art direction 
that backdrop looked immaculate after the trim. also special mention to snack-bot for the 3am donut delivery reminder (helped morale) :doughnut:
snack-bot: Reminder set: "Demo backdrop tidy-up" tomorrow 09:00. (reminder created)
people-ops: We'll send Kyle and DevOps a tiny thank-you box + a sticker pack "On-the-fly Fixer". If anyone else chipped in, DM me and we'll add you to the card :mailbox_with_mail:
sara: I'll make a quick kudos card and drop it at the bench. poll for celebration treats today? react with :one: for cookies, :two: for iced coffee, :three: for pretzels :thinking_face:
liam: :two: iced coffee please. and more zip ties for Kyle next time :sweat_smile:
people-ops: Cards + iced coffee ordered. thanks for the heads-up. adding this to the monthly kudos roundup :star2:
